title: Shroud of Turin dating tested later repair cloth

tellings.quote: there were several repair jobs that were done to it. And so you have se several pieces of cloth that were much younger than the original piece of cloth.

plain: The Shroud of Turin, a linen cloth long revered as the burial cloth of Jesus, was dated using pieces from later repairs, which were much younger than the original cloth. The researcher Randall Carlson says this on the show without naming a source, pointing to the several repair jobs done to it over the centuries, and if true the shroud could be much older than the dating suggested.
